Style.name: temperature_wow
Style.title: Filled contours (WOW)
Style.abstract: Air temperature filled with the UK Met Office WOW citizen-weather-station palette, bilinear-smoothed

Style.name: precipitation_wow
Style.title: Precipitation classes (WOW)
Style.abstract: Total precipitation rate shaded in standard logarithmic classes (1-2-5 per decade), white through gray, red and black, bilinear-smoothed, with contour lines drawn on the same class boundaries

Style.name: temperature_contour
Style.title: Air temperature contours
Style.abstract: Bilinear shaded air temperature with contour lines every 2 degrees

Style.name: temperature_contour_smooth
Style.title: Air temperature contours (smoothed)
Style.abstract: Same as temperature_contour, with a SmoothingFilter applied to reduce grid-scale noise before tracing contour lines

Style.name: temperature_contour_dashed
Style.title: Dashed contour lines
Style.abstract: Dashed contour lines on a transparent background, no fill - same pattern as the production pressure_cwk style

Style.name: temperature_contour_outlined
Style.title: Contour lines with outlined labels
Style.abstract: Solid, smoothed, gray contour lines on a transparent background, no fill - same pattern as the production pressure_cwk style used for isobars, with a white textstrokecolor and a widened textdistance so labels stay legible and sparse, like a synoptic chart

Style.name: pressure_msl_contour_outlined
Style.title: Pressure contour lines with outlined labels
Style.abstract: Solid, smoothed, gray isobars on a transparent background, no fill, every 4 hPa - same pattern as the production pressure_cwk style, with a white textstrokecolor, widened textdistance, and lines drawn through the labels (textgap=false), like a synoptic weather chart

Style.name: pressure_msl_contour_outlined_extrasmooth
Style.title: Pressure contour lines with outlined labels (extra smoothed)
Style.abstract: Same as pressure_msl_contour_outlined, with a heavier SmoothingFilter of 10 instead of 4, for an even cleaner synoptic-chart look on noisier fields

Style.name: pressure_msl_contour_blue
Style.title: Blue pressure contour lines
Style.abstract: Solid blue isobars on a transparent background, no fill, every 4 hPa - an alternate marine/shipping-forecast style chart palette (plain blue lines and labels with a white text halo, so labels stay legible over any background)

Style.name: temperature_shaded
Style.title: Air temperature classes
Style.abstract: Air temperature shaded in fixed 4-degree classes from -52 to 48, using a wide-range multicolor palette

Style.name: temperature_shaded_contour
Style.title: Air temperature classes with contour lines
Style.abstract: Same classed palette as temperature_shaded, with a SmoothingFilter of 4 and blue contour lines every 2 degrees overlaid

Style.name: temperature_shaded_extrasmooth
Style.title: Air temperature classes with extra-smoothed contour lines
Style.abstract: Same classed palette as temperature_shaded, with a heavier SmoothingFilter of 6 and blue contour lines every 2 degrees overlaid

Layer.Name: air_temperature_hagl_contourtest
Layer.Title: UWCW HA43 (DINI) 5.5km air temperature, for contour testing
Layer.Abstract: High resolution (338x282) air temperature field used to test contour line tracing

Layer.Name: air_pressure_msl_contourtest
Layer.Title: UWCW HA43 (DINI) 5.5km mean sea level pressure, for contour testing
Layer.Abstract: High resolution (300x300) mean sea level pressure field used to test isobar-style contour line rendering

Layer.Name: total_precipitation_rate_contourtest
Layer.Title: UWCW HA43 (DINI) 5.5km total precipitation rate, for contour testing
Layer.Abstract: High resolution (338x282) total precipitation rate field, rendered with the WOW precipitation palette

Style.name: country_outline_light
Style.title: Light gray country outlines
Style.abstract: Thin, light gray country border polylines, similar weight to the isobars - meant as a synoptic-chart style base map, lighter than the standard black overlay style

Layer.Name: country_outlines_contourtest
Layer.Title: Light gray country outlines, for use as a synoptic-chart style base map under contour tests

Style.name: country_land_light
Style.title: Light land fill
Style.abstract: Fills country polygons with a pale off-white land color, leaving the sea transparent so a request own BGCOLOR shows through - meant to be drawn under country_outline_light and the isobars, like the land/sea distinction on a synoptic weather chart

Style.name: country_land_green
Style.title: Green land fill
Style.abstract: Fills country polygons with a classic map green (the same #CCFFCC used by the production baselayer style), leaving the sea transparent so a request own BGCOLOR shows through - a more traditional-map-looking alternative to country_land_light

Layer.Name: country_land_contourtest
Layer.Title: Light land fill polygons, for use as a synoptic-chart style base map under contour tests
